name: Pythia's Well

stars.name: Pythia
stars.notes: Remarkably quiet main-sequence star; its stable output and gentle wind make it an anchor for pilgrimage routes across the Reach.

planets.name: Cindra
planets.notes: Sun-scorched iron cinder used as a navigation calibration point.

planets.name: Ocrea
planets.notes: Ochre dune world dotted with abandoned way shrines from the first pilgrim caravans.

planets.name: Adytum
planets.notes: Temple world of the Oracle Concord, built around fissure vents that exhale a psychoactive vapor in which petitioners report visions.

planets.name: Bassos
planets.notes: Deep-banded giant whose moons host the system's fuel skimming and votive-lantern festivals each perihelion.

planets.name: Nekyia
planets.notes: Silent ice world reserved by Concord law as a burial ground for oracles who served on Adytum.

planets.name: Threnos
planets.notes: Dark captured worldlet at the system's edge; its slow rotation matches no known formation model.

anomalies.name: The Python Deep
anomalies.notes: A faint temporal gradient pulses up through Adytum's vents; the visions pilgrims breathe are increasingly believed to be genuine precognition riding the echo.

asteroid_belts.name: Omphalos Belt
asteroid_belts.notes: Concession mines extract votive metals and rare earths; every claim pays tithe to the temple estates on Adytum.

stations.name: Tripod Station
stations.notes: Sprawling pilgrim port where offerings are weighed, fortunes told, and outbound blessings sold by licensed mantic brokers.

stations.name: Castalian Ring
stations.notes: Concord-run observatory monitoring the Python Deep; its findings on vision accuracy remain sealed even to most oracles.

faction_control.notes: A religious administration open to all comers; secular traders tolerate temple law because the visions move markets.

history: Survey crews first logged Adytum as a routine garden world until landers reported shared dreams that later came true.
The Oracle Concord was founded within a generation, codifying vapor rites and claiming stewardship of the entire system.
Rival trading cartels now fund secret studies to commercialize prophecy, and the Concord's inner circle quietly argues over whether the Python Deep is answering prayers or asking them.
description: Pythia's Well is anchored by a placid yellow sun whose steadiness has made it a beacon for navigators for centuries. Six worlds attend it: scorched Cindra, shrine-dotted Ocrea, the verdant temple world Adytum, the vast banded giant Bassos, funeral ice on Nekyia, and dark Threnos keeping watch at the rim.

Heavy traffic funnels through Tripod Station, where pilgrims and profiteers alike queue for a breath of Adytum's sacred vapor. The Oracle Concord administers temples, tithes, and the delicate business of selling tomorrow's news today, while Castalian Ring measures the anomaly beneath the crust with instruments nobody outside its order may read.

Beneath the incense and commerce lies an unresolved dread: the visions have begun describing events no one wants — arrivals, burnings, a silence crossing the Reach — and the accuracy rate keeps climbing. Petitioners are told to ask small questions. The oracles themselves have stopped asking any.
